metadata.dcterms:title: ALGEBRAIC CONSTRUCTIONS IN THE CATEGORY OF VECTOR BUNDLES
metadata.dcterms:creator: ARCUS¸, CONSTANTIN M.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: In this paper we present the category of generalized Lie algebroids. Important results (a theorem of Maurer-Cartan type, theorems of Cartan type,...) emphasize the importance and the utility of the objects of this new category.
